name: Vercel
one_liner: Frontend cloud platform for deploying web apps, with a REST API and MCP tooling.
auth_notes: Pages document AI Gateway API keys and OIDC tokens (page 4). REST API token auth is not on the fetched pages.
access_notes: AI Gateway API keys are created in the dashboard (page 4). Cost and gating for REST API access are not stated on the fetched pages.

buildability.rationale: Public REST reference exists and API keys are self-serve, but the pages do not document REST auth, pricing, or rate limits. Verify before building.

identity.quote: Vercel combines the best developer experience with an obsessive focus on end-user performance. Our platform enables frontend teams to do their best work.

auth.quote: Every request to AI Gateway requires Vercel authentication. Use an AI Gateway API key or OpenID Connect (OIDC) token.

access.quote: API keys work anywhere, whether it's local development, external servers, or CI pipelines.

api_surface.quote: Interact programmatically with your Vercel account using the SDK or direct HTTP requests.

needs_human_reason: REST API auth method, pricing, rate limits, and webhooks are not on the fetched pages. Search snippets mention access tokens and an SDK, but those pages were not fetched.
